plan.notes: Source: 'BA/MAT Modern Languages: Writing Education 4+1 Program - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Modern Languages), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. Semester course credits sum to 138 (108 undergraduate + 30 graduate), matching the printed program total of 138. However, the individual semesters' printed totals differ from the summed course credits for Semesters 1 and 2: the plan prints 16 for Semester 1, but its courses sum to 15 (3+3+3+3+2+1), and it prints 15 for Semester 2, but its courses sum to 16 (3+3+4+3+3); the two differences cancel out. The sums here use the individual course credits as printed. The plan prints 'FREN 1014 Elementary French I or SPAN 1014 Elementary Spanish I' (and the Semester 2 follow-on) as 3-credit courses even though the course numbers suggest 4 credits - kept verbatim with 3 credits. The plan's upper-level writing electives list is given after the plan: ENGL 3003 Advanced Professional Writing, ENGL 4503 Creative Writing: Poetry, ENGL 4043 World Creation and Design, ENGL 3023 Technical Writing, ENGL 4513 Creative Writing: Fiction, ENGL 4103 Grant Writing, ENGL 3103 Advanced Composition, ENGL 4523 Writing: Special Topics, ENGL 4543 Creative Writ: Creative Nonfiction, ENGL 3243 Theory/Pract. of Writing Consultation, ENGL 4533 Writing: Special Topics II, ENGL 4793 English Internship.
